Commitments

Promises we make in writing

Each of these is a contract term, not a marketing line. Your security team can hold us to every one.

No training on your data

Models never learn from your workspace, and your prompts are never retained for training.

Logical isolation

Every workspace runs in its own isolated context, with encryption keys that belong to it alone.

SSO and SCIM

SAML single sign-on and SCIM provisioning ship on every enterprise plan, with no add-on pricing.

Full audit trail

Every question, answer and approval is logged, exportable, and reviewable by your admins.

Retention controls

You set how long anything is kept. Delete a workspace and it is gone within 30 days, backups included.

Region pinning

Choose EU or US at setup and your data is processed and stored in that region only.

The full commitments live in the security overview and the DPA.
